Introducing the Sunny Health & Fitness Endurance Smart Elliptical Trainer, a top-notch home fitness machine. It offers low-impact, full-body workouts that protect knee and ankle joints while targeting multiple muscle groups.Enhance your fitness journey with the SunnyFit APP, featuring over 1000 workout videos and expert trainers for personalized guidance and real-time tracking.Experience quiet, smooth operation with 15 levels of magnetic resistance. This heavy-duty elliptical supports up to 300 lbs and is ideal for daily workouts, rehabilitation, or recovery. Adjustable features ensure comfort and effectiveness. 
Track your progress with the digital performance monitor, recording time, speed, distance, calories, and heart rate. Pulse sensors provide real-time heart rate feedback for safe, effective workouts.Enjoy hassle-free assembly with clear instructions and a comprehensive user manual. With over 20 years of excellence, Sunny Health & Fitness offers top-quality equipment and unmatched customer service. Elevate your fitness with the Endurance Smart Elliptical Trainer today! 

• 【LOW IMPACT ON FULL BODY】The pedal exerciser offers a low-impact, full-body workout that minimizes stress on joints with a smooth gliding motion. Our all-in-one elliptical promotes healthy levels of calorie, cardiovascular, and muscle toning.

• 【UNDISTURBED WORKOUT】Experience a low-noise workout with our elliptical, featuring a belt drive system & 15 levels of magnetic resistance. Enjoy quiet, smooth operation for focused exercise. Ideal for solo sessions and family fitness.
• 【QUALITY ASSURANCE】The heavy-duty elliptical supports up to 300LB, 11-inch stride length (use extended length), and adjustable step height (8.7-15.1”), it suits various body types. Enjoy comfortable and effective daily workout with durability and reliability.
• 【ENJOY THE STRIVING】Enjoy the ultimate comfort with adjustable foot pedals and customizable height. Achieve higher fitness goals with anti-slip pedals and floor stabilizers. Easily move and store it with built-in wheels, perfect for any space.
• 【TRACK YOUR PROGRESS】Track various metrics by comprehensive dashboard. View your time, speed, distance, calories, heart rate, target heart rate, and odometer on the digital performance monitor. Train at your perfect intensity level every workout!
• 【FOCUS ON EXERCISE】With a built-in bottle and device holder, stay hydrated and entertained at same time. User-friendly and intuitively designed, everything you need is at your fingertips. No plug is required, ensuring you a seamless start.
• 【WHY PULSE SENSORS?】Sunny Heart Rate Monitor HR200 offers real-time heart rate feedback, allowing precise workout adjustments and ensuring training within target zones and alerting if heart rate exceeds safe limits during intense exercise.
• 【HASSLE-FREE ASSEMBLY】Say goodbye to complicated setups with our straightforward instructions, including a user manual, adjustment guide, and video tutorial. Sunny customer service is ready to assist! Focusing on your fitness goals with right-away!

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Stride Zone Elliptical
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Create a total body training experience in the comfort of your own home with the Sunny Health and Fitness SF-E3865 Stride Zone Elliptical. Mount the large non-slip foot pedals designed with a pronounced inner rim to help keep feet in place while you stride. Open your stride to a larger range of motion with the 20-inch stride length as you move the 44-pound flywheel. Get your upper body working with the curved multi-grip, non-slip, full potion handlebars to engage muscles in your arms, chest, shoulders, and back. Increase the intensity of your lower body musculature when you move through 16 levels of motorized smooth belt drive resistance. Each level will test your glutes, thighs, calves, and core to help you progress towards your fitness goals. Monitor your specific exercise intensity when you utilize the central hand pulse sensors. Track your workout time, distance, rpm, speed, odometer, watt, and calories using the backlit LCD console. Challenge yourself using one of the 7 workout modes or 12 pre-loaded workout programs. Personalize your cardiovascular fitness training with a heart rate transmitter compatible belt and computer control heart rate zone workout programs. Train along with workout videos when you place your device onto the built-in tablet holder. The durable design of this in-home elliptical trainer can support users up to 265 pounds. Hydration is always in reach with the convenient bottle holder. Front positioned transportation wheels and a large rear handle make this elliptical machine easy to move and store through your living space.
• SMART RESISTANCE: Computer-controlled magnetic resistance uses your heart rate reading to ensure that you're exercising within the optimal heart rate range to meet your goals. If your pulse is too high, the computer will lower the resistance to bring you back in range. If your pulse is too low, resistance will be increased. When unplugged, this power-saving elliptical exercise machine will allow you to work out at the last computer-controlled resistance setting used.
• 20 INCH STRIDE LENGTH: Open your stride as you move through 20 inches of fluid gait motion. The increased stride length increases the joined range of motion and muscular stretch to stimulate larger muscle action.
• PRE-LOADED PROGRAMS: Select one of 12 pre-loaded programs that provide a variety of training intensities to help you chose the right program to fit your goals.
• WORKOUT MODES: With 7 basic workout modes, this magnetic elliptical can help you train specifically for watt output, target heart rate, or heart rate control. Use the manual mode to control variables of your choice.
• PULSE MONITOR: Check your pulse rate safely at any moment during your workout with the centrally located pulse sensors.
• EASY STORAGE: Front positioned transportation wheels and a large rear handlebar make this elliptical cross trainer easy to move about your living or workout space when not in use.
• BOTTLE HOLDER: Holding your drinks is easy on this elliptical. Place your favorite workout beverage into the convenient bottle holder before your workout.
• DEVICE HOLDER: Be in control of your workout entertainment when you place your favorite multimedia device on the built-in tablet holder.

Measuring at 24L x 19W x 11H inches these low profile and compact exercise machines can be placed anywhere you choose to sit. Weighing only 25 pounds and equipped with a conveniently centered transportation handlebar, you can easily pick up and move this elliptical with ease. This under-desk elliptical arrives fully assembled! Convenient pre-assembly means you can save time, money, and energy on putting together your elliptical, simply unbox and begin your fitness journey!

Unlock your full potential with the Sunny Health & Fitness Medicine Ball, available in nine weight options to match your fitness level. fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Slam Ball 10LBS - SF-EB04-10
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Build total-body strength and endurance with the Sunny Health & Fitness Slam Ball. Perfect for slams, squats, and lunges, it targets arms, core, legs, and back for a full-body workout. The sand-filled, no-bounce core ensures safety and control, while the high-density shell resists cracking. A treaded, non-slip surface offers a secure yet comfortable grip. Available in 10–50 lbs options, it’s ideal for strength, cardio, and rehab at any fitness level.
【FULL-BODY STRENGTH TRAINING】From slams to squats and lunges, this slam ball engages your arms, core, legs, and back—delivering a total-body workout that builds strength, coordination, and endurance.
【BOOSTS POWER & RELIEVES STRESS】Designed for explosive movements, this slam ball improves speed and strength while providing a powerful outlet to reduce stress, boost mood, and sharpen focus.
【ULTRA-DURABLE CONSTRUCTION】Built to endure your toughest workouts, the high-density rubber shell absorbs impact and resists cracking—ideal for repeated high-intensity use.
【NO-BOUNCE, SANDFILLED CORE】The dead-weight sand-filled design prevents bouncing or rolling, offering better control and safety during powerful slams and throws.
【TEXTURED NON-SLIP GRIP】The rubber treaded surface ensures a secure but comfortable grip—even during sweaty, high-speed sessions—so you can train with confidence.
【MULTIPLE WEIGHT OPTIONS】Available in weights from 10 to 50 lbs, this slam ball supports users of all fitness levels—perfect for strength training, cardio, or rehab.                                                                                      【EST. IN SUNNY CALIFORNIA SINCE 2002】Sunny Health & Fitness delivers premium equipment with a commitment to quality. Backed by U.S.-based support and certified trainers, we offer a truly unmatched “Fit for Everyone” experience.

fields.AU:
The Sunny Health & Fitness Weightlifting Glove is designed to deliver comfortable protection, reliable grip, and everyday performance for a wide range of training styles. Foam-padded palms help guard against blisters and calluses while preserving natural bar feel, making it ideal for weightlifting, gym workouts, cycling, and strength exercises like rows, pull-ups, and machines. The non-leather microfiber palm enhances grip control to reduce slippage, while an adjustable wrist strap provides light stability without restricting movement. It features a breathable, flexible back and a true-to-size unisex fit, available in sizes S–XL. Designed for daily use, it supports confident, comfortable training session after session.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Kettlebell Set 50lbs
fields.AS:
10lb - 7.2L X 5.9W X 8.1H In

15lb - 8.9L X 7.1W X 10.2H In

25lb - 10L X 7.9W X 11.4H In
fields.AU:
Build strength, improve conditioning, and add more variety to your home workouts with the Sunny Health & Fitness Kettlebell Set 50 lb. This 3-piece fixed-weight set includes 10 lb, 15 lb, and 25 lb kettlebells, giving you multiple weight options for lighter movements, moderate strength training, and heavier lower-body exercises.Use the set for full-body movements such as goblet squats, deadlifts, two-hand swings, bent-over rows, standing overhead presses, Russian twists, core training, and conditioning circuits. The 10 lb kettlebell is ideal for warmups, controlled upper-body movements, and beginner-friendly exercises. The 15 lb kettlebell supports moderate strength work and circuit training, while the 25 lb kettlebell helps progress heavier movements such as swings, deadlifts, and lower-body training.
Each kettlebell features a durable HDPE outer shell with cement fill, a smooth wide handle, and a flat floor-friendly base. The wide handle supports comfortable one-hand and two-hand grip control, while the flat bottom allows each kettlebell to stand upright for easier storage between workouts. Designed for indoor home training, this compact set gives you a practical strength solution without needing a large rack of equipment.Use on a flat, dry, non-slip surface. Wipe clean with a wet cloth and store indoors in a dry, well-ventilated area. This item is a fixed-weight kettlebell set and is not intended for dropping, slamming, outdoor storage, or commercial gym abuse.
【3-PIECE 50 LB KETTLEBELL SET】 Build your home strength routine with three fixed-weight kettlebells: 10 lb, 15 lb, and 25 lb. The set gives you lighter, moderate, and heavier options so you can match the weight to your exercise, strength level, and workout goal.
【FULL-BODY STRENGTH TRAINING】 From swings and squats to rows, presses, deadlifts, and core twists, kettlebell training helps build strength, power, endurance, and body control. The three weight options give you the flexibility to train multiple muscle groups at home.
【WIDE SMOOTH HANDLES】 Each kettlebell features a smooth wide handle to support comfortable grip control during one-hand and two-hand movements. Move with confidence through swings, rows, squats, presses, deadlifts, and core exercises.
【DURABLE, FLOOR-FRIENDLY BUILD】 The high-density polyethylene outer shell with cement fill creates a practical fixed-weight design for everyday indoor workouts. The rust-resistant exterior gives home users a simple, low-maintenance alternative to exposed metal weights.
【STABLE FLAT BASE DESIGN】 The flat bottom helps each kettlebell stand upright for easier storage and helps reduce rolling between sets. The stable base supports controlled floor-based exercises and helps protect floors from scratches when used on a flat, dry, non-slip surface.
【COMPACT HOME GYM ESSENTIAL】 Add strength training to your home without a large machine, bench, or full weight rack. This kettlebell set is easy to store, easy to use, and ideal for beginners, home gym users, and anyone looking to build strength, stability, and conditioning.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Performance Interactive Series Recumbent Exercise Bike with Exclusive SunnyFit® App Enhanced Bluetooth Connectivity - SF-RB420031
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
The perfect balance of performance, value, comfort, technology, and convenience has arrived with the Sunny Health & Fitness Performance Interactive Series Recumbent Exercise Bike - SF-RB420031. Get even more connected with your fitness with the SunnyFit® App available on Google Play, or the Apple App Store. Incorporate resistance bands into your cardio biking sessions to add a whole new level of fitness. Whether you’re a senior looking to maintain an active lifestyle, too busy to get to the gym, or just enjoy working out in the comfort of your own home, the Sunny Health & Fitness Performance Interactive Series Recumbent Exercise Bike is a fit for everyone.
• SMART PERFORMANCE FITNESS: Pedal along with Sunny Health & Fitness expert trainers on the Sunny Health & Fitness SunnyFit® App. Connect your preferred mobile device through Bluetooth and view your performance metrics in real-time.
• SunnyFit® App: The all-new SunnyFit® App takes your Sunny workouts to the next level! View your live metrics displayed in real-time as you tour the world with real location maps. Get the results you want with customized workout plans. Explore 100+ workout videos that fit your schedule and goals. Compare your results on the exercise bike leaderboard, share your fitness experiences, get workout tips, and much more!
• DIGITAL MONITOR: If the monitor is not connected to the SunnyFit® App, it will display fitness metrics in real-time: Time, Speed, Distance, Calories, Odometer, Pulse, Scan.
• FULL BODY WORKOUTS: Included resistance bands adds a new dimension to your recumbent exercise bike routine by incorporating an upper-body training component into your workouts. 3 separate placement hooks allow for positional adjustment for your body or exercise lesson. Lift and swing the handlebars if focusing just on your lower body.
• ECO-PACKAGING: Sunny is not only committed to the improvement and development of a healthy lifestyle of fitness enthusiasts but also to our environment. This recumbent stationary exercise bike is packaged with the latest in recyclable, sustainable, and biodegradable materials while maintaining its protective structural integrity. Fully ISTA-6 certified to meet the most stringent durability standards.
• LARGE PADDED SEAT: This recumbent exercise bike features a seat that has over 2 inches of cushioning and measuring 16.7 inches wide and 12.6 inches long. Get the most comfortable and intense recumbent exercise biking experience.
• PULSE GRIPS: This bike has two seat-level pulse sensors that are easy to grab while you work out. Use the data from the pulse sensor to gauge your performance. Grab the ergonomic handlebars to maintain your balance while you exercise.
• MAGNETIC RESISTANCE: Smooth and adjustable magnetic resistance with 8 levels makes it easy to modify the intensity or follow along with our Sunny Trainers video lessons during your home workout sessions.
• TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: In tight spaces, you can tilt and roll for use or away for easy storage with convenient transport wheels allowing easy movement of equipment.

fields.AU:
Stay fit and healthy while working on your strength and endurance with the Sunny Health and Fitness Hydro Water Rowing Machine. The Hydro uses water as resistance that dynamically increases as you row to give you a full body workout in the comfort of your own home. The faster you row, the more resistance you’ll experience, an effective exercise for various muscle groups. This quiet and smooth rower comes with comfortable handles and an easy on-off design, allowing for optimal training while seated. With Bluetooth connectivity, the SunnyFit app keeps track of your exercise sessions and gives you access to an array of free, professional, trainer-led rowing workouts. Enjoy having any workout of your choice right at your fingertips, while feeling supported and inspired as a member of this like-minded community. This water rowing machine also has six different water levels to choose from, allowing you to create the proper resistance for your individualized fitness level. The machine’s comfortable seat and handles allow for full body workouts as well as low-impact cardio to promote healthy and strong joints.
• CONNECTED FITNESS: Download and join the SunnyFit community to access an array of free, professional trainer-led rowing workouts and hundreds of other fitness programs. In the app, track your progress, set fitness goals, access personalized workout plans, and compete with other community members to get to the top of the leaderboard. Have any workout of your choice right at your fingertips, while also feeling supported and inspired as a member of this like-minded community.
• QUIET AND SMOOTH: Designed to be smooth, quiet, and comfortable, the Hydro features an innovative sliding rail design for a more fluid rowing motion.
• DYNAMIC RESISTANCE: With dynamic resistance and a water flywheel, the harder you row, the more resistance you’ll get — so it automatically adjusts to the strength and skill of each individual.
• FULL-BODY WORKOUT EXPERIENCE: The Hydro Water Rowing Machine is engineered to provide the ultimate workout for your arms, legs, core, and cardiovascular system. Rowing workouts utilize 86% of your muscles, so you are sure to get a comprehensive workout anytime you use the Hyrdro.
• LOW-IMPACT CARDIO: Protect your joints while still challenging yourself. Our Hydro Water Rowing Machine allows you to improve cardiovascular health and build strength but is also gentle on your joints.
• 6 WATER LEVELS: With 6 different options for water tank levels on your Hydro, enjoy the ability to change resistance and intensity with each workout. The higher you fill the tank, the more resistance you will experience during your workout.
• TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: Move your rower with ease by using the built-in transportation wheels. Roll to your desired workout location, or store it out of the way when not in use.
• WORKOUT IN COMFORT: With a high clearance seat for easy on-off transitions and ergonomic handles, each workout on your Hydro will be comfortable and hassle-free.
• SUNNY STATE OF MIND: In our 20 years of serving the fitness community, we have impacted the lives of over 10 million customers, and we are confident that our products are not only built to last but will also enable you to achieve your strength goals. Our vision and core mission are to stand beside you throughout your entire process. We enable you to enjoy your workouts with our products and our SunnyFit app which comes with over 300+ workouts taught by our certified Sunny Trainers.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Obsidian Surge 500 m Water Rowing Machine
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Get a top-quality product for a top-quality workout. The Obsidian Surge 500 Water Rower will keep your workouts engaging and challenging. Studies have indicated rowing can work up to 85% of the body’s muscular system without the joint impact of other conventional cardio exercises. This in turn results in higher calorie expenditure in a shorter period. Elevate your workout and be more efficient with the Obsidian Surge 500 Water Rower.
• WATER PERFORMANCE: Row on the water in the comfort of your home. The water creates a smooth and steady rowing experience with every stroke. Instant resistance is available with the flywheel and 16 fan blades. The faster the fan blades spin the higher resistance and dynamic response caused by the harmonious interaction with the water, giving the user a unique experience.
• DESIGN: Constructed with LIGHTWEIGHT sturdy steel, for solid performance and durability. The 16 Hydro Blades mimic the dynamic movements of competitive rowing. Non- slip HD Handlebar is sweat-resistant and wide enough to accommodate different hand widths. A tear-resistant mesh belt withstands the stress of repeated pulling. Keep the rower sturdy and level with the adjustable leveling end caps.
• ERGO-EFFICIENT: Molded padded seat is designed to be comfortable and functional. The high-profile seat design is 17 inches from the ground, which allows user to get on and off the seat without bending and straining you back. Non-slip foot pedals with durable nylon Velcro straps keep feet secure. Footpads pivot to allow more freedom of the foot and ankle to ensure optimal rowing mechanics.
• FITNESS TECHNOLOGY: The R2 Fitness Meter is designed to accurately track all essential workout metrics i.e. Total Time, 500 m Time, SPM, Total Strokes, Calories, HR, Ambient Temperature, and more. R2 Fitness Meter allows the user to tailor a personalized workout or use the built preprogrammed features. Wireless connection with a compatible heart rate strap
• EASY STORAGE: High-density non-marking rubber wheels perfect for easy transport and store upright when not in use. Recommended to be placed upright against the wall for storage.
• ANT + HEART RATE BELT COMPATIBILITY: Compatible with ANT+ heart rate technology, like heart rate belts or watches, so you can measure an accurate pulse and monitor the effectiveness of your workout. When worn around your chest during your exercise routine, the pulse belt will transmit your heart rate to the advanced digital monitor. Heart rate belt sold separately.

fields.AU:
Tackle your fitness goals and experience a low-impact, full-body workout with the SF-RW5801 Synergy Power Motion Magnetic Rowing Machine by Sunny Health and Fitness. Engage your quads as you propel your legs back and forth on the ergonomic pivoting foot pedals. The oversized foot pedals move forward and backward with your feet to promote a powerful push that is sure to fire up those leg muscles. Grasp the foam-padded handlebar and begin your rowing workout. Crank up to 16 levels of magnetic resistance creating smooth and silent rows each time you pull. The large, sweat-resistant seat supports you during long exercise sessions keeping you comfortable and focused. The sturdy slide rail and frame support up to 285 LBS. 43 inches of slide rail length provides ample room to extend and retract your legs promoting form and efficiency for each row. Progress is key to keeping you motivated. Check out all your fitness stats on the easy-to-read monitor displaying time, speed, count, calories burned, total count, and count per minute. The folding rowing machine measure 77L x 23W x 22.5H inches and 36.3L x 23W x 47 H when folded upright. Rubber end caps adjust to the floor for stability while protecting possible scratches to floors. Achieve an incredibly low-impact cardiovascular exercise routine right at home with the SPM Magnetic Rowing Machine by Sunny Health and Fitness.
• ERGONOMIC FOOT PEDALS: Engage your quads as you propel your legs back and forth on the pivoting foot pedals with adjustable straps. Slip-resistant handlebar ensures secure grasp.
• OVERSIZED SEATING: Large padded seating smoothly glides along with the 43 slide rail inseam. The heavy-duty frame holds 285 LBS. While stabilizers promote stability.
• MAGNETIC TENSION: 16 Levels of tension ensure a versatile and challenging workout with virtually no maintenance.
• FOLDABLE ROWER: Convenient folding rower machine folds upright. Great for smaller in home gyms
• SPM MONITOR: Check out all your fitness stats on the easy-to-read monitor displaying Scan, Time, Count, Calories, and Total Count.

Tackle you fitness goals and experience a low impact, full body workout with the SF-RW5801 Synergy Power Motion Magnetic Rowing Machine by Sunny Health and Fitness. Engage you quads as you propel you legs back and forth on the ergonomic pivoting foot pedals. The oversized foot pedals move forward and backward with you feet to promote a powerful push that is sure to fire up those leg muscles. Grasp the foam padded handlebar and begin you rowing workout. Crank up to 16 levels of magnetic resistance creating smooth and silent rows each time you pull. The large, sweat-resistant seat supports you during long exercise sessions keeping you comfortable and focused. The sturdy slide rail and frame support up to 250 LBS. 43 inches of slide rail length provides ample room to extend and retract you legs promoting form and efficiency for each row. Progress is key to keeping you motivated. Check out all you fitness stats on the easy to read monitor displaying time, speed, count, calories burned, total count and count per minute. The folding rowing machine measure at 77L x 23W x 22.5H inches and 36.3L x 23W x 47 H when folded upright. Rubber end caps adjust to floor for stability while protecting possible scratches to floors. Achieve an incredible low impact cardiovascular exercise routine right at home with the SPM Magnetic Rowing Machine by Sunny Health and Fitness.

fields.AU:
Boost your in-home cardio exercise with the Sunny Health and Fitness Flywheel Rowing Machine. Use the belt-drive mechanism to produce smooth and powerful strokes while gliding along the 44.5-inch slide rail. Pull against the durable 5.5 lb flywheel to condition muscles in your shoulders and core. Adjust the 16 levels of magnetic resistance to modify workout intensity on the indoor rower. A glance at the easy-to-read digital meter to cycle through a digital monitor to track time, calories burned, distance, stroke count, and RPM. Use the mode button on the digital meter to tailor specific workout goals during each exercise session. The magnetic rowing machine, which supports up to 285 lb, has large foot pedals, comfortable seating, and stabilizing feet for safety and comfort. Take advantage of the transportation wheels to conveniently move the compact rower. Fold the indoor rowing machine upright to store it in limited spaces.
• RESISTANCE: Challenge yourself with dual resistance by engaging the 5.5 lb flywheel and 16 levels of adjustable magnetic resistance. Engage the quiet belt-drive system to produce powerful and smooth strokes on the cardio equipment.
• Digital Meter: Track your workout performance by using the digital meter. Cycle through time, distance, calories burned, stroke count, and RPM with one simple button. Use the mode button to set custom workout goals.
• Sturdy Design: Slide forward and back on the 44.5-inch rail (42.5" inseam) that supports up to 285 lbs. Adjust foot levelers on the magnetic rowing machine to ensure it sits securely on the ground.
• Comfort: Feel secure when you press your feet against the large foot pedals. Grasp onto the foam Handlebars that are designed to reduce fatigue.
• Easy Storage: Move the machine from room to room with the convenient transportation wheels. Store this magnetic rower machine in tight spaces by folding the slide rail upright.
• Bottle holder: Stay hydrated during intense workout sessions with a water bottle holder.

fields.N: 3 year structural frame, 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Experience unparalleled fitness with the Sunny Health & Fitness Water Rowing Machine, designed to elevate your workout with a unique inclined water resistance system. This machine offers an immersive rowing experience that perfectly mimics the dynamics of real water rowing, providing a smooth, rhythmic workout that adjusts automatically to your intensity level. Connect seamlessly with the SunnyFit APP, offering fee-free access to expert-led workouts and stunning virtual rowing tours from global waterways. With Bluetooth connectivity and the built-in double magnetic sensors, track real-time metrics such as distance, strokes per minute, calories burned and more tailoring each session to help achieve your goals efficiently. With over 20 years of excellence, Sunny Health & Fitness delivers top-quality fitness equipment backed by a dedicated U.S. customer service team. Enhance your fitness journey with the Sunny Health & Fitness Water Rowing Machine and experience the difference.
• ENHANCED CARDIOVASCULAR CHALLENGE】Push your limits with our 60-degree inclined water rowing machine, featuring a multi-blade design and rhythmic movement resistance. Resistance adjusts based on water level for tailored intensity in every session.
• 【SMART FITNESS SOLUTION】Dive into expert-led workouts on our fee-free SunnyFit APP. Explore global waterways with tour rowing videos from across the globe, connect via Bluetooth for real-time metrics, and elevate your training experience.
• 【ADVANCE PERFORMANCE MONITORING】Utilize built-in double magnetic sensors to track time, time/500m, SPM, distance, strokes, total strokes, calories, and pulse precisely. Monitor watts to gauge the intensity of your workout for effective fitness tracking.
• 【IMMERSIVE ROWING EXPERIENCE】Enjoy stationary pedals for perfecting form, an enhanced volute spring system for durability, and a realistic, smooth feel with comforting water sounds. Ensuring lasting comfort and superior performance with every stroke.
• 【GENTLE IMPACT, REALISTIC ROWING】Hydro rowing machine provides low-impact benefits with water resistance, minimizing joint strain. The soothing water sounds enhance focus and motivation, creating an effective and comfortable fitness experience.
• 【STURDY BUILD, HIGH RESISTANCE】Built with alloy steel and long rails, our water rower supports up to 300 LB (135 kg). Enjoy adjustable water resistance levels from 24 KGF to a challenging 36.9 KGF, providing a customizable and challenging rowing session.
• 【TRANSFORMATIVE CONVENIENCE】Engineered for effortless setup with a foldable, small footprint design, pre-assembled parts for easy assembly, and convenient transportation wheels—ideal for quickly creating your dynamic home gym.
• 【ERGO-EFFICIENT DESIGN】Experience a molded, padded seat at a comfortable 15.4 inches height. The high-profile design ensures effortless seating, minimizing strain on your back for enhanced comfort during your rowing exercise.
• 【ENHANCED WORKOUT ENJOYMENT】Make the most of your aerobic workout and don’t miss out on your favorite shows with a convenient device holder while staying hydrated with a dedicated bottle holder, ensuring optimal performance during training.
• 【20+ YEARS OF EXCELLENCE】Sunny Health & Fitness, a U.S.-based company, offers top-quality equipment with a commitment to excellence. Our dedicated U.S. customer service team and certified trainers ensure a truly unmatched FIT FOR EVERYONE experience.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Long Stride Curved Step Climber w/ 4 Incline Angles
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Bring powerful climbing cardio and lower-body strength training home with the Sunny Health & Fitness Curved Step Climber. Designed with a long 27.6-inch stride path, this home cardio machine delivers a smoother, more natural climbing motion than traditional short-step climbers while helping engage the glutes, quads, calves, and core. With 4 incline angles, you can customize each workout to match your fitness level and training goals. Higher incline settings shift you into a steeper climbing position that supports good posture and helps activate the quads, calves, and core as you push more through the ball of your foot. Lower incline settings help increase glute activation by allowing you to lean forward into the extended handlebar and use gravity to better isolate the glutes without compromising posture. The curved step path supports natural foot alignment, while smooth glide rollers help create a steady, controlled workout experience. Track your progress on the smart LCD monitor, including time, step count, calories, total count, and steps per minute. Built-in Bluetooth connectivity and wireless heart rate compatibility support a more connected training experience. Heart rate monitor not included. Sync with the free SunnyFit App to access trainer-led workouts, scenic routes, progress tracking, fitness challenges, and thousands of on-demand exercise sessions with no membership fees. Built with a stable, lightweight, and durable frame, 330 lb weight capacity, and transport wheels for easier movement, this curved step climber is made for dependable everyday home fitness.
Backed by over 20 years of Sunny Health & Fitness quality, U.S.-based support, and certified trainer guidance, this compact cardio and strength machine helps you build endurance, strength, and confidence from the comfort of home.
【LONG STRIDE CURVED CLIMBING MOTION】 Designed with a 27.6-inch stride path, this curved step climber delivers a smoother, more natural climbing motion than traditional short-step steppers. Adjustable incline angles and a fixed handlebar help support proper body positioning, target different lower-body muscle groups, and support cardio endurance, strength, and total-body performance.

【HIGH STEEP INCLINE QUAD, CALF & CORE WORKOUT】 Raise the incline for a steeper climbing position that supports good posture and allows you to push more through the ball of your foot, helping activate the quads, calves, and core for a more challenging climb.
【LOW INCLINE GLUTE-FOCUSED TRAINING】 Lower incline settings help increase glute activation by allowing a comfortable forward-leaning position with the extended handlebar. Lean into the movement to better isolate the glutes while maintaining proper posture.
【NATURAL FOOT ALIGNMENT】 The pedals maintain a consistent angle while following the curved motion path, helping support a smooth, controlled stride. This design promotes steady foot positioning for a more comfortable and natural climbing workout.
【SMART LCD MONITOR】 Track key workout data including time, step count, calories, total count, and steps per minute to monitor progress at a glance. Bluetooth connectivity and wireless heart rate compatibility support connected training. Heart rate monitor not included.
【SUNNYFIT APP CONNECTIVITY】 Sync with the free SunnyFit App for trainer-led workouts, scenic routes, progress tracking, fitness challenges, and thousands of on-demand exercise sessions. No membership fees required, making it easier to stay motivated from home.
【330 LB CAPACITY HOME FITNESS DESIGN】 Built with a heavy-duty frame, smooth glide rollers, and built-in transport wheels for easier movement when needed. Designed to deliver stable, dependable performance for everyday home workouts.
【TRUSTED SUNNY HEALTH & FITNESS QUALITY】 For over 20 years, Sunny Health & Fitness has helped millions of users build healthier lifestyles with accessible home exercise equipment. Backed by U.S.-based support, certified trainers, and long-term fitness guidance.

fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Turn short sessions into real results. The Sunny Health & Fitness Foldable Smart Cardio Step Climber (SF-S025025GY) uses bodyweight for low-impact cardio that works legs, glutes, and core. An extended 9.8"– 24.8" step range with a 21.5" stride lets you choose your reach while the start point stays fixed; no preset resistance means your core handles the stabilizing. Four handlebar positions help you find a steady, ergonomic grip, and the triangular frame folds fast for easy storage. Connect via Bluetooth to the SunnyFit® App for guided climbs, scenic routes, and progress tracking. The simple LCD shows time, steps, step rate, and calories so you can stay focused on the climb.
【TOTAL-BODY CARDIO AND STRENGTH】 Build endurance while toning key muscles. The smooth, low-impact climb keeps legs, glutes, and core working without beating up your joints.
【CLIMB HIGHER WHEN YOU WANT】 The stepper offers 9.8"– 24.8" of vertical travel (21.5" stride), so you decide how high to lift each step. The starting position stays put; your legs set the effort.
【BALANCE AND CORE ON EVERY STEP】 Each climb trains stability and control. With no preset resistance, your core naturally takes charge to keep you steady.
【COACHING THAT MEETS YOU WHERE YOU ARE】The SunnyFit app offers structured climbs, real-time metrics, scenic routes, and AI adaptive plans that adjust to your body data and progress.
【COMFORTABLE, ERGONOMIC FIT】 Four  handlebar positions help you find your ideal hand height and posture, giving steady support for users of different sizes.
【KNOW YOUR NUMBERS AT A GLANCE】 An easy-read LCD tracks time, steps, step rate, and calories, so you can track progress without breaking rhythm.
【SOLID FROM THE GROUND UP】 A heavy-duty triangular frame supports up to 300 lb, delivering a stable, confidence-boosting ride from warm-up to long sessions.
【FOLDS AWAY WHEN YOU’RE DONE】 Quick to stow and easy to live with—perfect for apartments, shared spaces, and compact home gyms.
【SHIFT THE MUSCLE FOCUS】 Tilt-adjustable footplates let you aim the work toward calves, quads, or glutes so your workouts never feel the same.
【EST. IN SUNNY CALIFORNIA SINCE 2002】Sunny Health & Fitness delivers premium equipment with a commitment to quality. Backed by U.S.-based support and certified trainers, we offer a truly unmatched “Fit for Everyone” experience.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Magnetic Ski Trainer Machine
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Bring full-body ski-style cardio home with the Sunny Health & Fitness Magnetic Ski Trainer Machine, a compact indoor ski machine designed to deliver a smooth, quiet, and effective total-body workout without the noise, bulk, or wall-mounting requirements of traditional ski ergs.Built for home gyms, apartments, garages, and shared spaces, this magnetic ski trainer simulates the powerful pulling motion of Nordic skiing to help activate your arms, shoulders, back, core, legs, and glutes in one coordinated movement. Unlike treadmills, exercise bikes, and steppers that mainly focus on the lower body, this full-body cardio machine helps you train more muscle groups at once for efficient conditioning, endurance building, and calorie-burning workouts.
The quiet magnetic resistance system creates a smoother, more controlled pulling experience that is ideal for daily home use. With 16 adjustable resistance levels, you can start with beginner-friendly cardio, build steady endurance, or increase intensity for interval training and HIIT-style conditioning as your fitness improves. Designed as a freestanding ski exercise machine, the included platform and self-supporting frame let you set up your workout station without drilling, wall mounting, or complicated installation. The compact footprint makes it easier to add ski training to your home fitness routine, while transport wheels help you reposition the machine when needed. For more workout variety, the SF-SK025001 supports double-arm ski pulls, alternating pulls, single-arm pulls, and seated pulling exercises, giving you more ways to train your upper body, core, and total body. Bluetooth connectivity pairs with the SunnyFit app so you can track workout metrics, follow guided training, set goals, and stay motivated every session. Smooth, connected, compact, and home-ready, the Sunny Health & Fitness Magnetic Ski Trainer Machine is ideal for anyone looking for a low-impact cardio machine that delivers full-body training, quiet performance, and versatile workouts in less space.
【QUIET MAGNETIC SKI TRAINER FOR HOME CARDIO】 Train with a smoother, quieter pulling experience powered by magnetic resistance, making this indoor ski machine ideal for apartments, shared spaces, garage gyms, and early morning cardio sessions.
【16-LEVEL RESISTANCE FOR BEGINNER TO HIIT WORKOUTS】Choose from 16 levels of magnetic resistance to match your fitness goals, from beginner cardio and steady endurance sessions to interval training and higher-intensity conditioning.
【FREESTANDING SKI MACHINE WITH NO WALL MOUNTING】 Set up your ski trainer without drilling, wall mounting, or rack installation. The included platform and self-supporting frame make it easy to add ski-style cardio to your home gym.
【FULL-BODY NORDIC SKI WORKOUT IN A COMPACT SPACE】Simulate Nordic skiing movements to engage your arms, shoulders, back, core, legs, and glutes in one efficient motion, helping you build endurance, coordination, and total-body conditioning.
【MULTIPLE PULLING STYLES FOR TOTAL-BODY TRAINING】 Add variety to your workouts with double-arm ski pulls, alternating pulls, single-arm pulls, and seated pulling exercises, helping support progressive training for different fitness levels.
【SUNNYFIT APP CONNECTIVITY TO TRACK EVERY SESSION】Bluetooth connectivity pairs with the SunnyFit app to support workout tracking, guided training, goal setting, and key performance metrics including time, count, distance, calories, strokes per minute, and pace.
【HOME-GYM READY BUILD WITH WHEELS & HANDLE STORAGE】 Designed with a steel-supported platform, wear-resistant standing surface, integrated handle hooks, and transport wheels, this magnetic ski trainer is made for convenient home use and easy repositioning.
【TRUSTED SUNNY HEALTH & FITNESS QUALITY】For over 20 years, Sunny Health & Fitness has helped millions of people build healthier lifestyles through accessible home fitness equipment. Backed by U.S.-based support, certified trainers, and a commitment to helping you stay active for the long term.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Manual Incline SMART Treadmill - SF-T4400SMART
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
This treadmill combines advanced features to deliver a comprehensive workout experience. Powered by a robust 2.2 horsepower motor with adjustable speeds up to 9 MPH and customizable incline levels, it caters to both brisk walkers and intense runners. The treadmill's connectivity through Bluetooth grants access to over 1,000 workouts and 10,000+ scenic routes, while the 9 pre-set programs add variety to your training regimen. An advanced digital monitor and integrated pulse sensors keep track of essential metrics and heart rate in real-time. Quick speed buttons and handrail controls ensure easy adjustments, and the spacious 49" x 16" cushioned running surface enhances comfort and joint protection. Built to support up to 285 LB with durable construction, it offers stability and long-lasting performance. For convenience, it features a soft drop folding mechanism for compact storage and an emergency stop clip for added safety. With over 20 years of excellence, Sunny Health & Fitness provides high-quality equipment backed by dedicated support and certified trainers for a superior fitness experience.
• 【POWERFUL DRIVE SYSTEM】This treadmill is equipped with a robust 2.2 horsepower motor and adjustable speed levels of up to 9 MPH for smooth and efficient performance whether you’re walking briskly or running intensely. 
• 【ADJUSTABLE INCLINE LEVELS】Offering 3 incline settings, this treadmill allows you to target different muscle groups and enhance calorie burn, providing a versatile and challenging workout experience that adapts to your fitness goals.
• 【CONNECTED FITNESS】Sync this treadmill to your smart devices via Bluetooth to the free SunnyFit app, opening access to over 1000+ workouts and 10,000+ scenic global rowing routes. Personalize and track your progress in real-time as you run.
• 【9 PRE-SET PROGRAMS】Features 9 pre-set programs designed to target specific fitness goals such as weight loss, endurance, and interval training. These programs add variety to your workouts, keeping your training routine engaging and effective.
• 【DIGITAL MONITOR & QUICK ACCESS BUTTONS 】The advanced digital monitor displays key metrics like time, distance, speed, and calories burned. Quick access buttons enable easy adjustments during your workout for a smooth, user-friendly experience.
• 【PULSE SENSORS & HANDRAIL CONTROLS】This treadmill features integrated pulse sensors and handrail controls for added convenience. For precise real-time heart rate tracking, consider the HR200, which can store up to 8 hours of BPM data (sold separately).
• 【CUSHIONED RUNNING SURFACE】Offers a 49" x 16" surface area, providing ample room for comfortable strides and accommodating users of various heights. The cushioned surface reduces impact on your joints.
• 【DURABLE CONSTRUCTION】Built to support up to 285 LB, this treadmill features a sturdy frame and high-quality materials that ensure stability and long-lasting durability. It provides reliable performance for both home and recreational use.
• 【EASY STORAGE & SAFETY】Features a soft drop folding mechanism for convenient, compact storage. Additionally, it includes an emergency stop clip to enhance safety and provide peace of mind while you exercise.
• 【20+ YEARS OF EXCELLENCE】As a premier brand, Sunny Health & Fitness delivers top-notch equipment dedicated to excellence. With our devoted support team and certified trainers, enjoy an unmatched FIT FOR EVERYONE experience.

Need a little extra motivation? Work towards all your fitness and movement goals with Sunny’s SF-T722051 Hybrid Treadmill! Featuring a brushless motor, you can expect a quiet and smooth experience, that promotes your natural running or walking stride. fields.AU:
Introducing the Sunny Health & Fitness Pegasus Smart Treadpad® Treadmill, a versatile and compact fitness solution designed to elevate your home workouts. With its 20-inch-wide running belt, this treadmill offers ample space for comfortable strides, providing an exceptional running experience. The treadmill boasts a range of features, including diverse workout programs that cater to different fitness levels and goals, allowing you to stay challenged and motivated. Stay in control with the convenient handlebar controls and quick speed buttons, ensuring seamless adjustments during your workout. The built-in Bluetooth connectivity allows you to connect your devices and enjoy the SunnyFit® App, providing access to over 1000+ training videos and immersive audio experiences. The treadmill's foldable design and transportation wheels make storage and mobility a breeze, ideal for those with limited space. Additionally, the shock absorption technology reduces impact on your joints, prioritizing your comfort and safety. Experience the convenience, performance, and space-saving design of the Sunny Health & Fitness Space-Saving Treadmill for an exceptional fitness journey from the comfort of your own home.
• Bluetooth Connectivity for Enhanced Workouts: Connect your treadmill to compatible devices using the built-in Bluetooth feature and unlock World Tours with the SunnyFit App. Sync your progress, track your goals, and access over 1000+ training videos and immersive audio experiences for a truly engaging workout session.
• Wide Running Surface for Comfortable Strides: Experience a wider and more comfortable running session with the treadmill's spacious 20-inch running surface. Stand out from other compact treadmills and enjoy ample space to move.
• Convenient Handlebar Controls and Quick Speed Buttons: Stay focused and in control throughout your workout with the treadmill's easy-to-use handlebar controls. Adjust speed and settings seamlessly, without disrupting your exercise routine. Take advantage of the quick speed buttons for instant intensity adjustments with a simple touch.
• Joint-Friendly Shock Absorption: Prioritize joint protection with the treadmill's advanced shock absorption technology. Reduce the impact on your joints while running, ensuring a comfortable and safe workout experience
• Robust Frame and Stability: Designed with a rock-solid frame, the treadmill delivers unparalleled stability, providing you with a secure and confident workout experience. No matter how intense your training gets, you can rely on the steadfast foundation to keep you balanced and supported throughout your fitness journey.
• Diverse Workout Programs for Varied Fitness Goals: Achieve your fitness targets with ease using the treadmill's 12 preset programs and 3 customizable programs. Enjoy a wide range of workout options designed to cater to different fitness levels and goals, ensuring you stay challenged and engaged.
• Real-Time Feedback with Digital Monitor: Stay informed and motivated during your workout with the treadmill's digital monitor. Get real-time feedback on essential workout metrics such as time, distance, speed, and calories burned, allowing you to track your progress and stay motivated. Pulse sensors integrated into the handlebars enable you to monitor your heart rate during workouts.
• Secure Device Holder with Convenient USB Charging: Keep your tablet or phone securely in place with the treadmill's device holder. Stay entertained by watching videos or following workout apps for added motivation. Plus, conveniently charge your devices while you exercise using the built-in USB port, ensuring they're ready for use afterward.
• Easy and Space-Saving Storage: With its foldable design, the treadmill can be effortlessly folded and stored in a compact space within minutes. Perfect for those with limited room or for keeping your treadmill conveniently out of the way when not in us.
